name: Romande Energie Holding S.A.
summary: Romande Energie Holding SA is a Swiss energy enterprise dedicated to the generation, delivery, and commercialization of electrical and thermal power throughout Switzerland. The company produces electricity utilizing a diverse portfolio of renewable sources, including hydropower, solar, wind, and biomass. Beyond energy production, it manages and develops critical infrastructure for both electricity distribution and fibre optics, while also spearheading new projects focused on renewable energy. Romande Energie provides comprehensive services ranging from energy marketing, billing, and customer support via its call center, to offering specialized guidance to clients transitioning to cleaner energy solutions. Established in 1901, the company's headquarters are located in Morges, Switzerland.
